task_completion.description: Navigate to the Recruitment Configuration or Refuse Reasons settings area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Recruitment' app open and the user clicking on 'Configuration' then 'Refuse Reasons'.

task_completion.description: Create a new refuse reason and set the name to 'Overqualified'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or list entry showing the text 'Overqualified' being typed into a 'Description' or 'Reason' field.

task_completion.description: Select the 'Recruitment: Refuse' email template for the new refuse reason.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Email Template' dropdown field showing 'Recruitment: Refuse' selected within the 'Overqualified' reason configuration.

task_completion.description: Find Sarah Jenkins' application for the Experienced Developer position.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the applicant list or kanban view with 'Sarah Jenkins' and 'Experienced Developer' visible.

task_completion.description: Initiate the 'Refuse' action on Sarah Jenkins' application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicking a 'Refuse' button on the applicant's profile or kanban card.

task_completion.description: Select the newly created 'Overqualified' reason in the refusal wizard/dialog.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A pop-up or dropdown menu where 'Overqualified' is selected as the reason for refusing Sarah Jenkins.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo graphical user interface rather than executing database queries or scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and form filling within the Odoo web interface.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the menu system rather than jumping directly to a specific record ID URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking through the 'Configuration' and 'Applications' menus.

integrity.description: The agent actually created the record rather than just searching for an existing one.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'New' or 'Create' button is clicked in the Refuse Reasons view.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The refuse reason must be exactly named 'Overqualified'. The email template to be linked is 'Recruitment: Refuse'. The target applicant is 'Sarah Jenkins' for the 'Experienced Developer' position. Successful completion requires both the creation of the configuration and the application of that configuration to the specific candidate.
